tasks.label: SecKit: Sync Submodules
tasks.command: git submodule sync --recursive && git submodule update --init --recursive

tasks.label: SecKit: Update Tracked Tool Mirrors
tasks.command: git submodule sync --recursive && git submodule update --init --remote --recursive

tasks.label: SecKit: Refresh Nuclei Templates
tasks.command: bash -lc 'if command -v nuclei >/dev/null 2>&1; then nuclei -update-templates; else echo "nuclei launcher not found; run bootstrap.sh first."; fi'
